h: Coca-Cola's Indian bottling parent files IPO papers; Thums Up and Maaza maker's revenue up 20%
k: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed draft papers with SEBI for a share sale of up to about 99.7 crore shares. Coca-Cola's stake would fall from 60% to roughly 45%.

h: Swiggy renames itself 'Sweety' for Diwali, down to the delivery bags
k: For the festive season the food-delivery brand has swapped its name on hoardings, rider jerseys, bags and social handles to celebrate India's love of mithai.

h: Meesho closes its ₹186.71 crore Kirana Club deal, adding 4.1 million kirana shops
k: The e-commerce company now owns 92.74% of the kirana-network app and its Indian arm, as it pushes into business-to-business trade outside the big cities.

h: Ramayana: Part One crosses ₹200 crore gross in India in three days
k: Nitesh Tiwari's Diwali release, starring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, is at ₹208 crore gross after its first weekend day, though Hindi screens are running at only 35% full.

h: 10 years after demonetisation, cash in circulation is at a record ₹43.46 lakh crore
k: The 8 November 2016 note ban was meant to curb black money and push digital payments. UPI exploded, but India's cash habit survived.

h: DeepMind's AI agents find two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
k: Google DeepMind says human-guided AI agents cut the theoretical cost of forging some RSA signatures by about 1,600x. Modern 2048-bit keys are not affected.

h: OYO parent PRISM posts ₹353 crore Q1 profit, but ₹244 crore is a tax credit
k: Revenue rose 35% to ₹2,814 crore, yet most of the profit growth comes from a one-off deferred tax credit rather than cash from hotels.

h: New-age scorecard: Nykaa profit jumps 207%, Lenskart doubles, Swiggy's loss narrows
k: Three consumer-internet names reported July–September results. Two are solidly profitable now, while Swiggy is still losing money but less than last year.

h: Delhi's air hits AQI 369 on Diwali eve, with 'severe' forecast for today and tomorrow
k: Sixteen of 59 monitoring stations were already in the severe band on Saturday, and experts warn some could cross 450 after tonight's fireworks.

h: Agniveers get two more years: Cabinet clears a 'second tour of duty'
k: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said willing Agniveers can stay on and be enrolled as regular soldiers after four or six years if they meet selection criteria.

h: Peppermint Robotics raises ₹100 crore to scale robots worldwide
k: The Pune and Austin-based startup closed a pre-Series B led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners, roughly $10.5 million.

h: Starlink India still hasn't launched, and the ₹8,600 price was test data
k: Despite its licence and a Jio distribution deal, Starlink was not taking consumer orders in India as of 6 November.

h: LPG check for November: commercial cylinder up ₹10, home cylinder unchanged at ₹942
k: Petrol and diesel prices are also unchanged, while jet fuel went up ₹1.30 a litre.

h: Axon invests $1.2 billion in drone maker Skydio at a $5.2 billion valuation
k: Only $255 million is fresh capital; the rest buys existing shares. Axon becomes Skydio's exclusive public-safety distributor in the US and Canada.

h: US sets up Task Force Iron Gate to extend its Iran blockade to land routes
k: CENTCOM also disabled another commercial ship in the Gulf of Oman, the 11th since the naval blockade began in July.

h: Wall Street ends its worst week in over a year, even after a Friday bounce
k: The S&P 500 fell 2.7% for the week and the Nasdaq logged a fourth straight weekly loss, as AI stocks sold off before a partial rebound.

h: Reliance jumps 8% on record Q2; Jio Platforms trades 28% above IPO price
k: Shares rose on 2 November after Reliance posted record quarterly revenue, EBITDA and profit, taking its market value above ₹17 lakh crore.

h: CarTrade leads new-age stocks, up 23% in a week as 54 of 69 tracked names gain
k: Foreign buying, Q2 earnings and lower crude helped the Inc42 basket, while the Nifty Midcap 100 rose 5.8%.

h: India win rain-hit 2nd ODI by 4 runs (DLS) to lead New Zealand 2-0
k: Gurnoor Brar took a career-best 4/30 in Wellington as New Zealand were bowled out for about 134 chasing a revised target.

h: Dhinidhi Desinghu becomes the first Indian with two Youth Olympics medals
k: She took bronze in the 200m freestyle in Dakar, while Tirthank Pegu won bronze in the 200m butterfly. India's tally is now six.

h: Chennaiyin FC thrash defending champions East Bengal 5-3 in ISL goal-fest
k: Brison Fernandes scored twice in the first 18 minutes and Irfan Yadwad added two more after the break.

h: Leeds beat Tottenham 1-0 with a late Noah Okafor goal
k: The substitute's goal ended Spurs' winning run in Saturday's Premier League action.

h: Suriya's Scene earns ₹81.5 crore worldwide in two days
k: The Diwali action-comedy added ₹20.25 crore net in India on Saturday, up 5.7% on opening day.

h: Godzilla Minus Zero heads for a record $32 million US opening
k: It would be the biggest ever US opening for a live-action foreign-language film, ahead of The Cat in the Hat.

h: A venomous primate feared extinct for a century is alive in Indonesia
k: The Bangka slow loris, last recorded in the 1930s, has been found again, thanks largely to a rescue centre's records.

h: 25,000 people from 50 countries help buy a 9,400-acre estate for wildlife
k: The Wildlife Trusts raised about £30 million to protect Rothbury Estate in Northumberland, home to a Bronze Age hill fort.

h: After a failed first crop, a 57-year-old grew soil-free strawberries and sold ₹44 lakh
k: Ketan Sodha, a Mumbai commerce graduate with no farming background, now grows strawberries year-round in Mahabaleshwar.

h: A 100-year-old peepal was lifted by a 50-tonne crane and replanted, and it's growing
k: Tree-transplantation expert Bharat Sisodia saved an Ahmedabad peepal after it was cut down, moving it nearly two kilometres.

h: A Delhi fellowship pays rural performers a stipend to learn theatre
k: Bargad's six-month programme pays ₹10,000 a month, rising to ₹15,000 from January 2027, funded by individual donors.

h: After 28 years and 31,000 miles on foot, Karl Bushby is home in Hull
k: The former paratrooper reached home on 2 November and hugged his mother, Angela, at her gate.

h: Angel One overtakes Zerodha to become India's No. 2 broker
k: New NSE data for October puts Angel One ahead of Zerodha by active clients for the first time. Groww is still far ahead at No. 1.

h: Remember Karbonn? It's back with a ₹11,999 phone and a 7,000mAh battery
k: The Indian phone brand that ruled budget shelves a decade ago has returned with the Rebel series, betting on battery life over 5G.

h: Ramayana crosses ₹100 crore in India in just two days
k: Nitesh Tiwari's mega-budget epic has earned about ₹112.9 crore net in India and roughly ₹220 crore worldwide since Thursday's release.

h: Mamaearth's parent Honasa grows profit 87% to ₹73 crore
k: The D2C beauty company behind Mamaearth posted strong September-quarter numbers, with revenue up 36%.

h: OpenAI raises $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
k: Bloomberg reports the ChatGPT maker's round could reach about $20 billion — but at a lower price than it was aiming for in September.

h: Harsh Jain teases a 'brand new Dream11' by end-December
k: After the real-money gaming ban killed its paid contests, Dream11's CEO says a rebuilt app for sports fans is coming.

h: ED searches CoinDCX and Delta Exchange over crypto trades sent abroad
k: The Enforcement Directorate says the two exchanges allegedly routed crypto derivatives and tokenised stock trades overseas without permission. Delta denies it.

h: Burger King India launches a black-bun 'Doomsday Whopper' for Avengers
k: As Marvel's official restaurant partner in India, Burger King has rolled out a villain-themed menu from ₹199 ahead of the film's December release.

h: Sensex jumps 1,718 points as foreign money pours back into India
k: The Sensex and Nifty rose about 2% on Friday and over 8% for the week — their best week in six years.

h: India beat Japan 4-1 to win a record 6th Asian Champions Trophy
k: Down 0-1 for most of the final, India scored four goals in the last 18 minutes in Mohali to complete a hat-trick of titles.

h: Minister says voter ID, not Aadhaar, may be used for benefit payments
k: Union Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh said biometrics and the voter ID number would be the basis for paying beneficiaries. No official policy has been announced yet.

h: 67 Israeli MPs back Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form the next government
k: President Herzog will announce on Sunday who gets the first chance to form a government after last month's election.

h: MakeMyTrip buys majority stake in carpooling app Quick Ride
k: The travel giant is entering daily commutes, adding Bengaluru's Quick Ride to a ground-transport stable that already has redBus and Savaari.

h: Claude can now read your bank transactions and flag odd charges
k: Anthropic's new Personal Finance beta connects bank and card accounts through Plaid. It's US-only for now and read-only.

h: Jewellery brand GIVA raises $100 million to open 1,000 stores
k: The fine-jewellery startup's round is led by Multiples, just as India heads into Diwali shopping.

h: US economy adds 165,000 jobs in October, far above forecasts
k: Unemployment fell to 4.1%, a surprise after a rough week for US stocks.

h: NSE shares hit a record; exchange now worth over $50 billion
k: India's biggest stock exchange touched ₹1,953.95 a share after strong September-quarter profits.

h: Tata Punch EV beats Mahindra XEV 9S by just 45 units in October
k: India's best-selling electric car race is down to a photo finish, with EV sales up about 76% from last year.

h: Turkey ratifies a NATO-style defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan
k: The Mecca agreement commits the three countries to help each other if one is attacked.

h: EloElo raises $80 million from NBCUniversal to grow microdramas
k: The parent of Story TV is betting that Indians will pay for bite-sized vertical dramas.

h: India hold off Pakistan 3-2 in SAFF Championship opener
k: Suhail Bhat scored twice as the defending champions led 3-0 at half-time in Dhaka, before two late Pakistan goals.

h: Bengaluru startup Aina unveils a $399 AI ring with its own screen
k: The ring tries to guess your next three actions and lets you approve them with a flick.

h: Bank of India waives processing fees on home and car loans till March 2027
k: Borrowers with a CIBIL score of 725 or more can skip the fee; EV car loans qualify regardless of score.

h: Paraguay's president tries to resign after a digital bank collapses
k: Congress refused Santiago Peña's resignation and moved towards impeachment after Ueno, used by about 3 million people, failed.

h: Cabinet clears ₹2,814 crore to build lithium and nickel plants in India
k: The scheme gives a 30% capital subsidy for four processing plants to cut dependence on imports for EV batteries.

h: 15-year-old Tanvi Patri wins India's first Youth Olympics women's singles silver
k: She pushed world junior champion Zhang Yi Xin to 26-24 in the deciding game of the final in Dakar.

h: US Justice Department sets up a 'Super Intelligence' task force
k: The new team will go after foreign states, criminal groups and fraudsters who misuse advanced AI.

h: MobiKwik gets an RBI lending licence, eyes ₹5,000 crore in loans
k: The fintech's subsidiary can now lend directly as an NBFC, starting within three to six months.

h: India go for 2-0 against New Zealand in today's 2nd ODI
k: After Virat Kohli's 74 sealed the rain-hit opener, the series moves to Wellington.

h: Diwali weekend on OTT: Haiwaan, The Vvaan and Last Man in Tower
k: Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, Sidharth Malhotra and Manoj Bajpayee lead this weekend's streaming picks.

h: Seabird colony wiped out by bird flu bounces back to 756 terns
k: At England's Pagham Harbour, sandwich terns have returned in big numbers after vanishing in 2022.

h: These Tamil Nadu villages skip Diwali crackers every year — to protect bats
k: In villages across the state, people have chosen quiet Diwalis for generations so fruit bats roosting nearby aren't scared away.

h: Critically endangered pangolin caught on camera near Shillong
k: A Wildlife Institute of India camera trap recorded a Chinese pangolin in forests on the edge of the city.

h: Brazil expands Pantanal park, home to the world's most jaguars
k: The protected area in the world's largest tropical wetland has grown by 185 square miles.

h: Barbados stops HIV passing from mothers to babies, WHO confirms
k: No baby in Barbados got HIV from their mother between 2022 and 2024.

h: This Maharashtra village now makes 500 litres of drinking water from air
k: A machine built with CSIR-IICT scientists pulls moisture out of the air for children in drought-prone Washim.

h: Nature is being restored at the fastest rate ever recorded, says UN
k: About 252 million hectares across 149 countries are now under active restoration, a UNEP report finds.

h: A Gurugram student built a free app that measures light pollution from a phone photo
k: Class 12 student Suhani Gupta's SkyQi has collected readings from 490+ people in 63 countries.

h: Blinkit Ambulance will now charge ₹2,500 for non-emergency trips
k: Emergency rides stay free. Routine trips like check-ups and hospital-to-home transfers will now be paid.

h: Deepinder Goyal hits back at doctors over his ‘Temple’ wearable
k: Doctors called the ₹85,000 brain-tracking gadget a scam. Goyal says the science will prove them wrong.

h: OpenAI could go public in 2027
k: The ChatGPT maker's president says the company could be ready for a stock market listing next year.

h: A viral video got a PVR juice counter shut in Bengaluru
k: A moviegoer alleged that used cups were being reused. Food safety officials inspected — and shut the counter.

h: India set for a ₹1 lakh crore Dhanteras
k: Traders expect record shopping today — led by gold and silver, even though gold is about 20% costlier than last year.

h: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
k: After 23 years and a record 146 goals, the 41-year-old is done playing for Portugal — but he isn't leaving Al-Nassr.

h: Democrats win both houses of the US Congress
k: In Tuesday's midterm elections, Democrats took control of the House and the Senate — the first time in 20 years a Republican president has lost both.

h: Wall Street loses $2.5 trillion in a single day
k: The Nasdaq fell 5.5%, its worst day since April 2025, as AI and chip stocks crashed.

h: Tankers catch fire in the Strait of Hormuz
k: Iran says at least five tankers and a tugboat caught fire, several after hitting mines. Oil crossed $100 a barrel.

h: Iran lets Indian ships through the Strait of Hormuz
k: Indian vessels are exempt from Iran's shipping restrictions in the world's most important oil route — though they still pay a fee.

h: Delhi's air turns "severe" before Diwali
k: The capital's average AQI crossed 450 this week, and stricter GRAP-II curbs are now in force across the NCR.

h: Drone-delivery startup Zipline raises $1.5 billion
k: Its valuation has nearly tripled in about ten months, and Walmart is adding about 300 more drone-delivery locations.

h: Google plans a $17 billion AI data center in Wyoming
k: It will be Google's first in the state, powered largely by a giant fuel-cell plant.

h: Google, Meta and TikTok sue California over teen feeds law
k: The law limits autoplay and personalised feeds for users under 16. The companies say it breaks free-speech rules.

h: OpenAI's new AI found 81 serious Firefox bugs
k: A cybersecurity model for approved researchers is finding and helping fix software holes at a scale humans could not.

h: Airtel's profit jumps 24% as users pay more
k: Bharti Airtel's quarterly profit rose to ₹10,710 crore, helped by higher revenue per user.

h: LIC's profit rises 20% to ₹12,076 crore
k: India's biggest insurer had a strong September quarter, though new first-year premiums dipped slightly.

h: Microsoft pulls back, AI cloud stocks tumble
k: Microsoft passed on a bigger deal with Nscale and is tightening oversight of its AI cloud partners. Their shares fell sharply.

h: Palantir's revenue nearly doubles to $2.31 billion
k: The data and AI software company had its first $2 billion quarter and raised its outlook for the year.

h: India storm into the Asian Champions Trophy final
k: The defending champions beat South Korea 8-1 in the semi-final in Punjab to reach a record seventh final.

h: TRAI proposes separate licences for satellite internet
k: The telecom regulator wants satellite players under a new set of rules — and not selling directly to customers.

h: 40 US towns vote NO to AI data centers
k: Voters rejected new data-center projects, angry about power bills and pollution.

h: AMD plans $11 billion in AI acquisitions
k: A filing shows the chipmaker wants to buy World Labs and inference-chip startup Taalas.

h: Defence startup Shield AI buys Echodyne for $5.3 billion
k: The AI drone-pilot maker is buying a radar company and raising $2.5 billion at a $28.8 billion valuation.

h: Grubhub owner Wonder files to go public
k: Marc Lore's food company — which also owns Blue Apron — has confidentially filed for a US IPO.

h: India's services sector picks up speed in October
k: The HSBC India Services PMI rose to 55.8, showing faster growth in businesses like IT, banking, travel and retail.

h: Deepti Sharma in the race for ICC Player of the Month
k: The all-rounder was shortlisted after a match-winning show against Zimbabwe.

h: What to watch this weekend on OTT
k: Dulquer Salmaan's I'm Game, Netflix's Dilwali Diwali and a new season of Black Doves lead this week's releases.

h: Joyalukkas sets aside ₹100 crore for charity
k: The jewellery brand will fund homes, girls' education, elderly care and medical help.

h: Tata Trusts gave ₹1,556 crore — and plans up to 50 hospitals
k: The Trusts want a network of not-for-profit hospitals where those who can pay help cover those who can't.

h: Gene therapy helps blind patients see objects again
k: In a new trial, people blinded by an inherited eye disease could detect and find everyday objects.

h: A short truce in Ukraine got nearly 800 people to safety
k: A six-day ceasefire in the town of Oleshky let aid in and people out. More peace talks are planned next week.

h: Two teen brothers rescue a family from a flooded home
k: When emergency crews couldn't get through, they paddled in with a kayak and a paddleboard.

h: 8 tiger cubs bring new hope to a Rajasthan sanctuary
k: It's the first successful tiger breeding recorded at Kailadevi in nearly 30 years.

h: Saffron blooms on barren land in Ladakh
k: A pilot farm in Leh flowered in under a month and gave 22 grams of saffron in four days.

h: Bengal's "Foodman" runs 20+ free study centres for children
k: A college professor gives children free meals and free coaching across West Bengal.

h: This Bhopal café swaps your trash for a meal
k: Bring plastic, paper or household waste — walk out with food. 45 tonnes recycled so far.

h: IIT Bombay's free tool warns farmers of drought 4 weeks early
k: KrishiDrought uses satellites and AI to forecast dry soil for every district in India.

h: Students fill a football field with food for families in need
k: A New Jersey high school collected more than 250,000 pounds of food in one drive.
